quarantined_leads.lead: A September 7 FCPA Professor report said Judge Nicholas Garaufis again denied without prejudice the DOJ's request to dismiss FCPA and obstruction charges against five remaining defendants in United States v. Adani.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Judge Garaufis Again Denies DOJ Request To Dismiss FCPA (And A Related Charge)
